About me

I build systems that
work while you sleep

I am a CRM Specialist with hands-on experience delivering complete, end-to-end CRM builds for insurance agencies, mortgage firms, and service-based businesses. I don't just configure software — I translate how a business actually works into automated systems that capture leads, nurture prospects, onboard customers, and drive retention, all without manual effort.

My core strength is lifecycle automation: building the full journey a lead takes from first contact to loyal customer, with every touchpoint automated, scheduled, and optimized. No lead falls through the cracks. No follow-up gets missed. No customer feels forgotten.

Case studies

Case study 01
Full AgencyZoom CRM build — insurance agency
AgencyZoomInsuranceFull CRM buildLifecycle automation

Complete end-to-end CRM implementation for an independent insurance agency covering Personal Lines, Commercial Lines, and Life & Health. Transformed a manually managed agency into a fully automated lead and customer management system.

✓5 pipelines configured — Sales, Service, Onboarding, Renewal, Claims
✓5-day quoted lead cadence — 13 automated touchpoints across email, SMS, and call tasks
✓12-month Smart Cycle nurture campaign — 15 touchpoints across 365 days
✓Welcome sequences for all three lines of business (Personal, Commercial, Life & Health)
✓Renewal reminders — email, SMS, and call tasks at 60, 30, and 7 days prior
✓Shot Clock — auto-moves stale quoted leads to Smart Cycle after 6 days
✓Birthday texts, holiday campaigns, Google Review automation
✓Custom fields, field mapping, lead sources, policy types, and loss reasons
